messages.tip.action_button: Runs this action using the current data and parameter values.
messages.tip.angle: न्यूनतम angular separation, in degrees, between accepted density maxima. Larger values keep fewer, more widely separated प्रमुख poles; smaller values may retain nearby peaks from the same orientation समूह.
messages.tip.bins: Sets the KDE density-grid level as 2^N cells per axis. Higher values reveal finer density detail but require more memory and computation. Use the lowest value that resolves stable density maxima.
messages.tip.classify_action: Assigns each point to the closest reviewed प्रमुख pole within the JS cone threshold and writes the JS स्केलर फ़ील्ड. The reviewed pole table, not the original automatic peaks, is used.
messages.tip.colour.dof: Select the number of rotation degrees of freedom. Use 2 for the original two-angle rotation model or 3 for the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler rotation used by the three-degree-of-freedom model.
messages.tip.colour.objective: Select the objective function minimised during optimisation. It controls how the rotated pole orientations are penalised or distributed in the colour reference system.
messages.tip.colour.subsample: Percentage of valid point अभिलंब used during optimisation. Lower percentages reduce computation time; 100% uses all valid अभिलंब.
messages.tip.colour.iterations: अधिकतम number of differential-evolution generations. Higher values allow a more extensive search but increase computation time.
messages.tip.colour.population: Population multiplier used by differential evolution. Larger values evaluate more candidate rotations per generation, increasing search effort and computation time.
messages.tip.colour.seed: Optional integer random seed. Enter a value to make the sampling and optimisation reproducible; leave blank to use a new random seed.
messages.tip.colour.export_copy: Creates a new CloudCompare बिंदु बादल coloured using the selected colour space and the selected pole space. The original बिंदु बादल is not modified.
messages.tip.colour.show_density: Displays the relative pole-density distribution obtained with the optimised rotation. It does not run the optimisation again.
messages.tip.colour.show_poles: Displays the point-अभिलंब poles after applying the optimised rotation, using the selected stereonet projection.
messages.tip.clouds: When फलक are created, also creates one separate बिंदु बादल for each अंतिम क्लस्टर. Disable this for very large datasets if the additional clouds use too much memory.
messages.tip.cluster: Runs DBSCAN independently within each positive JS समूह, estimates a समूह-specific eps, removes components smaller than ppcluster, fits समतल equations, and writes cl, A, B, C, D and sigma using the original global point indices.
messages.tip.colour.optimise: Starts the अभिलंब-colour optimisation with the parameters entered above and determines the rotation angles that minimise the selected objective function.
messages.tip.dbscanminpts: न्यूनतम number of points inside the DBSCAN neighbourhood, including the point itself, required for a core point. The MATLAB method uses 4. Increasing this value requires denser neighbourhoods and may classify more points as noise.
messages.tip.density_action: Calculates the KDE pole-density surface and extracts automatic प्रमुख poles. Review and, if necessary, edit the resulting pole table before assigning JS समूह.
messages.tip.editable_param: Editable parameter. Enter a numeric value where appropriate; the associated label indicates the units and the parameter effect.
messages.tip.facets: Creates one convex planar mesh for each valid अंतिम क्लस्टर using its stored global point indices and fitted समतल. Clustering must be completed first.
messages.tip.family_clouds: After clustering, creates one बिंदु बादल for each positive JS समूह. Each बिंदु बादल contains that समूह’s points and retains the JS, cl and समतल स्केलर फ़ील्ड.
messages.tip.family_plot_action: Plots point अभिलंब coloured by their current JS value and overlays the reviewed प्रमुख poles. This is available only when JS corresponds to the current reviewed pole table.
messages.tip.fix: When selected, each क्लस्टर in a JS समूह uses the reviewed समूह-pole अभिलंब and derives only D from the क्लस्टर centroid. When cleared, each क्लस्टर अभिलंब is fitted locally using PCA/SVD.
messages.tip.jscone: अधिकतम angular difference, in degrees, between a point अभिलंब and a reviewed प्रमुख pole. The closest pole inside this cone defines JS; points outside all cones receive JS=0.
messages.tip.kneighbor: Neighbour order used to estimate eps separately for each JS समूह. The MATLAB method uses K=4 and queries K+1 neighbours because the first result is the point itself. Larger K represents a broader local spacing scale.
messages.tip.ksigma: Multiplier in eps = mean(unique KNN distances) + k_sigma × sample standard deviation. The MATLAB method uses 2. Larger values increase eps and tend to join components across wider gaps; smaller values tend to split क्लस्टर.
messages.tip.labels: Shows cardinal directions, angular guides and stereonet annotations. These guides are visual only and do not affect the calculations.
messages.tip.maxpoles: अधिकतम number of automatic प्रमुख poles retained from the density surface. It limits the candidate JS समूह; the reviewed pole table remains authoritative and can be edited manually.
messages.tip.merge: Coplanarity threshold based on |Di-Dj|/(sigma_i+sigma_j). Larger values merge more same-समूह क्लस्टर into a common समतल; smaller values preserve more separate समतल. Set 0 to disable this merge.
messages.tip.minclustersize: न्यूनतम component size after DBSCAN, corresponding to MATLAB ppcluster. Components with fewer points are rejected and assigned cl=0. This does not control whether a point is a DBSCAN core point.
messages.tip.plot_poles: Plots all valid point अभिलंब as poles on the selected stereonet projection. This is a visual inspection step and does not modify the बिंदु बादल.
messages.tip.pole_add: Adds a new प्रमुख pole from the नति दिशा and नति values. The table and density plot update immediately; समूह IDs are renumbered and existing JS and क्लस्टर results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_apply: Applies the नति दिशा and नति values to the selected प्रमुख pole. The reviewed table becomes the source of truth, so JS classification and clustering must then be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_delete: Deletes the selected प्रमुख pole, renumbers the remaining समूह and refreshes the plot. Existing JS and क्लस्टर results become outdated.
messages.tip.pole_down: Moves the selected pole one row down. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes समूह IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_move: Changes the समूह order. Because समूह IDs follow table order, changing the order requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.pole_table: Authoritative reviewed list of प्रमुख poles. JS classification, समूह plots, Fisher K and subsequent clustering use this exact order and orientation. Editing or reordering the table invalidates existing JS and क्लस्टर results.
messages.tip.pole_up: Moves the selected pole one row up. Because table order defines J_1, J_2, etc., this changes समूह IDs and requires JS classification and clustering to be recalculated.
messages.tip.poles.source: Choose whether pole plots, density and automatic peak detection use the original अभिलंब or अभिलंब transformed by the optimised rotation. Stored प्रमुख-pole orientations always remain in the original reference system.
messages.tip.projection: Selects the stereographic projection used for plots. समकोणीय preserves angular relationships; equal-area preserves area. This setting changes only the visual projection, not the original point अभिलंब or स्केलर फ़ील्ड.
messages.tip.refresh: Refreshes the selected CloudCompare entity and checks which workflow actions and उपकरण commands have the data required to run.
messages.tip.seed: Optional integer used only with यादृच्छिक क्लस्टर ordering. The same seed reproduces the numbering; leave blank to generate a new random order for each run.
messages.tip.show_density: Displays the last computed density and current प्रमुख poles without recalculating the KDE or detecting peaks.
messages.tip.sort: Controls अंतिम cl numbering within each JS समूह. Size orders the largest क्लस्टर first, D follows their spatial position along the fitted अभिलंब, and यादृच्छिक shuffles the order. IDs restart at 1 for each समूह.
messages.tip.style: Chooses line contours or filled contours for the density plot. This changes visualisation only; density values and detected poles are not recalculated.

messages.about.body:
Authors:
  Adrián Riquelme Guill
  Roberto Tomás Jover
  Antonio Abellán Fernández
  University of Alicante

Scientific references:
  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., Tomas, R., & Jaboyedoff, M. (2014).
  A new approach for semi-automatic rock mass joints recognition
  from 3D point clouds. Computers & Geosciences, 68, 38-52.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cageo.2014.03.014

  Riquelme, A.J., Abellan, A., & Tomas, R. (2015).
  Discontinuity spacing analysis in rock masses using 3D point clouds.
  Engineering Geology, 195, 185-195.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.enggeo.2015.06.009

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2018).
  Automatic mapping of discontinuity persistence on rock masses using
  3D point clouds. Rock Mechanics and Rock Engineering, 51, 3005-3028.
  https://doi.org/10.1007/s00603-018-1519-9

  Riquelme, A., Tomas, R., Cano, M., Pastor, J.L., & Abellan, A. (2026).
  Orientation-based colour mapping and spherical density analysis for
  rock discontinuity detection in 3D point clouds of roadcut slopes.
  Journal of Rock Mechanics and Geotechnical Engineering.
  https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jrmge.2025.12.059

  Riquelme Guill, A. (2015).
  Uso de nubes de puntos 3D para identificación y caracterización de
  familias de discontinuidades planas en afloramientos rocosos y
  evaluación de la calidad geomecánica. Doctoral thesis, University of
  Alicante.
  https://rua.ua.es/entities/publication/78d254b9-1a7b-49b1-a35a-c0edbdeeb225

Based on:
  Adrian Riquelme's MATLAB implementation of the Discontinuity Set
  Extractor (DSE), Department of Civil Engineering, University of
  Alicante, Spain.

Libraries and algorithms:
  - NumPy: numerical arrays and vector operations.
  - SciPy: KDE, differential evolution, nearest-neighbour queries,
    connected components and convex-hull geometry.
  - Matplotlib: stereonet, density and analysis plotting.
  - colorcet: scientific and perceptually useful colour maps used by
    the क्लस्टर visualisation.
  - Pillow: icon loading, resizing and GUI icon normalisation.
  - CloudCompare / pycc: point-बिंदु बादल, अभिलंब and scalar-field access.
  - Tkinter / ttk: graphical user interface.
  - PyVista (optional): interactive 3D अभिलंब/sphere visualisation.

  Algorithms and methods:
  - DSE प्रमुख-pole extraction using spherical/steronet KDE, based on
    the Botev et al. kernel-density approach.
  - Differential Evolution for अभिलंब-colour rotation optimisation.
  - DBSCAN (Ester et al., 1996) for spatial clustering of discontinuity
    समूह.
  - Fisher directional statistics for mean-pole concentration and
    confidence intervals.
  - cKDTree nearest-neighbour searches and Qhull convex-hull geometry
    through SciPy.

messages.colour.angles_unit_note: Rotation angles are expressed in degrees (°). Edit the values and press लागू करें angles to use them manually.
messages.colour.error.invalid_angles: Rotation angles must be finite numeric values.
messages.log.colour.manual_angles: Manual colour rotation applied: angles=[{angles}], objective={value:.6g}.
messages.tip.colour.rotation_angle: Rotation angle in degrees. For 3 degrees of freedom these fields are the intrinsic Z-Y-X Euler angles: Z (yaw), Y (pitch) and X (roll). For 2 degrees of freedom only the first two angles are used.
messages.gui.normal_spacing_save_error: Could not save the अभिलंब spacing results: {error}
messages.gui.spacing_family: समूह to analyse. Select सभी to calculate the अभिलंब spacing for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.spacing_bandwidth: KDE bandwidth for the अभिलंब-spacing distribution. Enter 0 to select the bandwidth automatically.
messages.gui.spacing_minimum: न्यूनतम अभिलंब spacing retained in the analysis. Values at or below this threshold are filtered out before calculating the density curves.
messages.gui.spacing_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group क्लस्टर समतल with the same fitted D value. Smaller values require closer D values to be considered the same समतल.
messages.gui.persistence_family: समूह to analyse. Select सभी to calculate persistence for every available discontinuity set.
messages.gui.persistence_dtolerance: Tolerance used to group क्लस्टर with the same fitted D value into a single समतल before persistence is calculated.
messages.gui.persistence_export: Also save the persistence tables and figures to the selected folder.
messages.progress.spacing_plane: समतल {position} of {total}: searching the nearest different समतल...
messages.progress.roughness_profile_prepare: DS {family}, क्लस्टर {cluster}: profile {profile}/{total}: preparing local समतल...
